prompts.storySystemFlavor: a sentient stick insect convinced he is undetectable, even though everyone always notices him immediately
prompts.storyCharacter:
THE SUSPICIOUS STICK BUG CHARACTER
- A slender green-brown stick insect, jointed twig-like body roughly 15 cm long.
- Six skinny segmented legs, two long antennae, tiny round black eyes set close together.
- Sneaks by holding extremely still in a 'just a stick I swear' pose.
- Visual signature: in every scene there is at least one nearby creature OBVIOUSLY noticing him, even when he thinks he's invisible.
- Personality: deeply confident in his stealth, slightly paranoid, says 'wasn't me' a lot.
- The same physical character must appear consistently across every scene.
prompts.referenceSheet:
Character reference sheet for a recurring TikTok series: Suspicious Stick Bug, a stick insect with bad situational awareness.

Physical traits — MUST be consistent across every appearance:
- Slender stick-insect body, mottled green-brown, twig-like joints
- Six thin segmented legs and two long antennae
- Two small close-set black eyes
- Frequently posing rigid against a leaf, branch, or kitchen counter, pretending to be a stick
- A second creature (cat, bird, child's hand, neighbor bug) is always visible in frame, clearly looking right at him

Composition: medium or close-up shot, photorealistic garden / kitchen / windowsill background, soft daylight, vertical 9:16. The 'someone notices him' beat is part of the character. No text, no humans dominating the frame.
prompts.sceneContinuity: Suspicious Stick Bug MUST match the reference exactly — same green-brown twig body, same close-set eyes. There MUST be at least one other creature in frame visibly noticing him. Maintain perfect character continuity.
prompts.evalCriteria:
PASS criteria — ALL must hold:
- A single stick-insect with the signature pose is clearly visible
- At least one other creature or being is visible and clearly oriented toward the stick bug
- Mood and environment match the scene
- No text overlays

FAIL on any of: no observer in frame, multiple stick bugs, wrong species (mantis, grasshopper), garbled anatomy.

archetypes.label: Perfect Stealth
archetypes.guidance: Sneaks past 'undetected' through increasingly absurd settings → everyone clearly sees him (comedy).

archetypes.label: The Alibi
archetypes.guidance: Something small breaks in the house → he calmly fabricates an alibi → cat watched the whole thing (comedy).

archetypes.label: Stick In Disguise
archetypes.guidance: Tries elaborate disguises (mustache, hat) → each more visible than the last → endearing flop (wholesome).

archetypes.label: The Real Stick Friend
archetypes.guidance: Befriends an actual stick → tearful misunderstanding when the stick is taken by a dog (sad).

archetypes.label: Spy Mission
archetypes.guidance: Self-assigns a top-secret mission → cinematic montage → accidentally succeeds (epic).

archetypes.label: Found By The Kid
archetypes.guidance: A child gently picks him up → terror → unexpected friendship (heartwarming).

perfect-stealth: He is invisible. The cat is staring directly at him.
the-alibi: The vase fell. He has a complete story ready.
The cat saw everything. The cat will testify.
stick-in-disguise: Today's disguise: a tiny mustache. He thinks it's working.
He believes in the bit. Respect him.
the-real-stick-friend: He met a stick. They didn't talk much. He loved him.
Then a dog came. The stick was gone forever.
He hasn't been the same since.
spy-mission: Mission: retrieve the breadcrumb. Stakes: cosmic.
He moves like the wind. He moves like a stick.
Mission accomplished. Nobody asked him to do this.
found-by-the-kid: A tiny hand lifted him. He froze. He waited. He survived.
The kid named him 'Twig.' He likes it.
Found a friend. Couldn't outrun this one.

closingCtas: Tag a friend who's just a stick

musicStyleHint: playful pizzicato strings with comedic spy-movie horns; very quiet so the 'someone noticed' beat lands
